description: Deleting _build/<env>/lib/<app>/ebin/*.so (or the defk cache) left the module's on_load failing; mix compile did nothing, because Mix calls __mix_recompile__?/0 only on modules that load (Mix.Compilers.Elixir: Code.ensure_all_loaded, then function_exported?). Only mix compile --force repaired it. Fix: lib_defs/1 for an app module declares the installed library as @external_resource; Mix marks the source stale when the file is gone. Done when: release_layout_test deletes the library and cache, a plain mix compile rebuilds it, and the expected on_load warning is asserted.
title: A kernel module whose library is missing from ebin/ is never recompiled
